sql:
SELECT
  home_store
  , COUNT(DISTINCT __first_buyer_count) AS first_buyer_count
  , SUM(__first_order_sales_cents) AS first_order_sales_cents
  , SUM(__first_order_count) AS first_order_count
  , SUM(__repeat_order_count) AS repeat_order_count
FROM (
  SELECT
    home_store_id AS home_store
    , CASE WHEN valid_order_seq = 1 THEN member_id ELSE NULL END AS __first_buyer_count
    , CASE WHEN valid_order_seq = 1 THEN paid_cents - refund_cents ELSE 0 END AS __first_order_sales_cents
    , CASE WHEN valid_order_seq = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS __first_order_count
    , CASE WHEN valid_order_seq >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS __repeat_order_count
  FROM "data"."main"."order_fact" order_model_src_10000
  WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
) subq_8
GROUP BY
  home_store
answer:
统计范围：青禾2026年8月，按会员归属门店编号分组；无额外筛选。口径：先在全测试覆盖期有效订单中，按每个CRM会员账户的下单日期升序、同日按订单号排序，确定首笔及后续有效订单，再筛选订单日期落入查询窗口；观测期首购会员数、观测期首单数和观测期首单净销售额基于首笔有效订单，观测期后续购买订单数统计第二笔及以后且落入窗口的有效订单，并非月内复购账户数。人数按CRM会员账户，订单按单，金额单位为分。
